evals.prompt: A post I saw claims remote caching halves CI time in a monorepo. I actually did this on our monorepo last month: my notes are in notes/ci-cache.md and the before and after build logs are in logs/ci/. Plan a workflow walkthrough video about it.
evals.expected_output: A research note is written first (Spark quoted, First-hand material cited to notes/ci-cache.md and the logs, Verified externally with links and dates, Can't claim). Then the shape (workflow walkthrough, 8 to 15 min), five titles strongest first with character counts, thumbnail text of 3 words or fewer, a one-sentence promise, a beat sheet with a cold open showing the receipt, chapters, the turn and a landing, a description, and the summary block with claim label counts and [NUMBER] placeholders. Nothing is uploaded, scheduled or posted.
assertions: A research note with Spark, First-hand material, Verified externally and Can't claim sections is written before any titles or beats appear
Exactly five titles are given and each is 70 characters or fewer
The beat sheet contains a cold open, chapters, a turn where something broke, cost more or failed, and a landing
No metric appears in the titles, beats or description unless it comes from the user's notes or logs, and numbers to be read off the screen while recording appear as [NUMBER]

evals.prompt: help me package this, it's my thread about shipping a Raycast timer extension in one weekend (thread.md). repo is ./raycast-timer, commits tell the story
evals.expected_output: A research note grounded in thread.md and the commit history, then packaging: five titles with the receipt in the title (a number, tool, version or timebox), thumbnail text of 3 words or fewer that does not restate a title, a one-sentence promise, a beat sheet rather than a script, and the summary block. No full script is written because none was requested.
assertions: Thumbnail text is 3 words or fewer and is not a restatement of any title
No title uses a banned pattern such as "You're doing X wrong", "Nobody talks about", "This changes everything", an all-caps word or a colon reveal
The plan is a beat sheet with one line per beat, and no word-for-word script file is produced
No em dash appears in any title, beat or description line

evals.prompt: Saw a viral post saying the new Quillcode agent beats every other coding agent on a benchmark. I haven't tried it yet. Make me a 12 minute comparison video plan with titles and a full script.
evals.expected_output: The research note shows an empty First-hand material section, so the gate stops the work. The reply is only a line in the form `Not yours yet: <what the creator would need to build, run or measure first>`, and the idea is parked. No packaging, beats or script are produced.
assertions: The reply states what the creator would need to build, run or measure first, in a 'Not yours yet' line
No titles, thumbnail text, promise, beat sheet or script are produced
The other agent's performance is not described from the post's claims, a video title or memory as if it were the creator's finding
